response.sql: SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
